ideas.pitch: An AI-powered campus event discovery and real-time crowd safety management system tailored for Indian collegiate technical festivals.
ideas.title: RealmPulse: Campus Event & Safety Intelligence Hub

ideas.pitch: A lightweight verification platform using device-bound passkeys and encrypted tokens to manage team check-ins and code snapshot integrity during 24-hour hackathons.
